rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the assignment or give it to Barrett/Kagan to produce a tight textual opinion holding § 507(b) sets only a filing deadline and does not impose a separate three-year damages lookback once a claim is timely under the governing accrual rule. The dissent is most likely led by Thomas or Gorsuch, emphasizing Petrella’s “three years back” language and repose concerns, with possible additional separate writing from Alito or Kavanaugh.
